context.transcript:
On behalf of the Woodlands Historical Foundation, I want to welcome you all to our fund-raiser.
As you know, Owe're raising money to restore our archives building.
In addition to holding priceless materials, it is one of the city's most beautiful structures.
We had a string quartet flying in from Chicago to perform for us tonight, but Owe just heard that there is fog at the airport.
Owe'll begin by presenting our proposal for the restoration.
Please enjoy some refreshments, which were graciously donated by the owners of Olson's Restaurant.
context.transcript_translation:
我代表Woodlands Historical Foundation，欢迎大家参加我们的筹款活动。
如您所知，我们正在为修复我们的档案建筑筹集资金。
除了保存无价的材料外，它也是这座城市最美丽的结构之一。
我们原本请了一支来自芝加哥的弦乐四重奏来为我们表演今晚，但我们刚刚听说机场有雾。
我们将从介绍我们的修复提案开始。
请享用一些茶点，这些是Olson's Restaurant的老板们慷慨捐赠的。
